title: Kampf um Rom II - Der Verrat
director: Robert Siodmak, Andrew Marton, Sergiu Nicolaescu
writer: David Ambrose, Felix Dahn, Ladislas Fodor
actors: Laurence Harvey, Orson Welles, Sylva Koscina
plot: Cethegus starts the war between the Ostrogoths and their queen, Amalasuntha, and the Byzantine Empire, but when the Byzantine army invades Italy to reconquer Rome, romance prevails and threatens to ruin the plans for Cethegus.
